title: Vengeance UI: shadcn-registry animated React marketing components
summary: Open-source animated React component library for marketing landings: 46 shadcn-registry components across button hovers, text motion, bento layouts, displacement effects, and scroll-driven cards. Installed via npx shadcn add @vengeanceui/[component].
question_it_answers: Which shadcn-installable library ships scroll and hover motion for marketing landings?

claims.text: Vengeance UI ships 46 animated React components installable through the shadcn registry CLI.
claims.evidence: 46 components in 9 families. shadcn registry CLI install.

claims.text: Install command is npx shadcn@latest add @vengeanceui/[component].
